key_impacts: Damage to the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station leading to a long-term decommissioning programme
Fuel debris deposits identified in Units 1-3
Large volumes of contaminated water required treatment and on-site storage, reaching about 1,100,000 m3 by October 2018
Ongoing production of contaminated water measured at approximately 490 m3/day in FY2015, reduced to about 200 m3/day in the first half of FY2018 through countermeasures
missing_information: Human health and evacuation impacts not detailed in this document
Broader directly affected settlements or exclusion zones beyond the facility are not specified
